facts.statement: Technosaurus is an extinct genus of silesaurid dinosauriforms named after Texas Tech University.
facts.quote: Technosaurus (meaning "Tech lizard", for Texas Tech University) is an extinct genus of silesaurid dinosauriforms

facts.statement: Fossils of Technosaurus were found in the Late Triassic Cooper Canyon Formation of Texas, United States.
facts.quote: from the Late Triassic Cooper Canyon Formation (Dockum Group) of Texas, United States

facts.statement: Technosaurus and its type species T. smalli were named by Sankar Chatterjee in 1984.
facts.quote: Technosaurus and its type species, T. smalli, were named by Sankar Chatterjee in 1984

facts.statement: The original description of Technosaurus was based on specimen TTUP P9021, which included a premaxilla, two lower jaw pieces, a vertebra, and an astragalus.
facts.quote: Technosaurus is based on TTUP P9021, which initially consisted of a premaxilla (tip of the upper jaw), two lower jaw pieces, a back vertebra, and an astragalus

facts.statement: Irmis et al. (2007) found no unambiguously dinosaurian characteristics in the skull fragments of Technosaurus.
facts.quote: Irmis et al. (2007) agreed with the removal of the vertebra and astragalus, but found no characteristics that were unambiguously dinosaurian in the skull fragments

facts.statement: Later studies concluded that Technosaurus is a valid genus but cannot be definitively classified beyond Archosauriformes incertae sedis.
facts.quote: These authors would later restate their case, concluding that Technosaurus, defined only by the premaxilla and non-Shuvosaurus lower jaw fragment, was a valid, diagnostic genus, but could not be definitely classified beyond Archosauriformes incertae sedis

facts.statement: Technosaurus lived during the Late Triassic, specifically the Norian stage.
facts.quote: que vivió a finales el periodo Triásico en el Noriense

facts.statement: Technosaurus fossils come from the Bull Canyon Formation (Dockum Group) in Texas, United States.
facts.quote: proveniente de la Formación Bull Canyon (Grupo Dockum) de Texas, Estados Unidos

facts.statement: Technosaurus belongs to the family Silesauridae.
Technosaurus is classified within the infraclass Archosauromorpha.
Technosaurus is placed in the unranked order Ornithodira.

The Paleobi Database classifies Technosaurus in the class Ornithischia.

rejected.statement: For about 20 years after its description, Technosaurus was thought to be a basal ornithischian dinosaur, but this interpretation is now doubted due to better remains of other Triassic archosaurs.
